audience: customer success and support teams that run NPS surveys and manage contacts in AskNicely

useCases.title: Check the NPS trend for recent periods
useCases.text: Get the Net Promoter Score for any number of recent days, optionally filtered by custom fields. Read the statistics of the surveys sent.

useCases.title: Review low scores and their comments
useCases.text: List survey responses since a unix time, newest or oldest first. Read the score and comment of each response.

useCases.title: Look up a contact before a follow-up
useCases.text: Get one contact by email, id or custom field, with its segment and last emailed time. Check the unsubscribed list too.

useCases.title: Add new customers to a segment without a survey
useCases.text: Add or update up to 500 contacts in one call. No survey is sent unless obeyrules is set to true.

useCases.title: Send one NPS survey to a customer
useCases.text: Send one NPS survey email, if the account's contact rules allow it. This emails a real customer.

useCases.title: Stop surveys for a contact
useCases.text: Deactivate a contact so the contact gets no more surveys. The contact is kept, not deleted.
